summary: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz warned that an Iranian attack on Israel would result in strikes against all Iranian infrastructure, including energy facilities, "returning Iran to the Stone Age," while Netanyahu declared all Israeli systems are working to topple the Iranian regime. Iran warned the US via Reuters that any Israeli military operation to capture Mount Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon — where IRGC and Hezbollah forces are deployed — would trigger a severe Iranian response. IDF completed clearing Hezbollah underground infrastructure in the Ali Taha ridge and achieved operational control of the area.
key_points: Netanyahu told i24 that all Israeli systems are working to topple the Iranian regime, stating it is on the verge of collapse, with all Israeli institutions operating under his direction. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80267)

Israeli DM Katz warned that an Iranian attack on Israel would result in strikes on all infrastructure, including energy facilities, returning Iran "to the Stone Age and darkness." (Source: @almogboker78/18121)

IDF spokesperson announced completion of clearing Hezbollah underground infrastructure in the Ali Taha ridge by the 36th Division, achieving operational control above and below ground. (Source: @amitsegal/64552)

Iran warned Washington via Reuters that any Israeli attack on IRGC and Hezbollah positions at Mount Ali al-Taher in southern Lebanon would trigger a severe Iranian response. (Source: @inon_yttach/10007)
Israeli Channel 14 senior political source stated Iran feels it has reached a dead end and the only way out is renewed war, describing the signs as "serious." (Source: @kianmeli1/91489)
Israeli security establishment assesses Hezbollah is trying to drag Iran into a campaign with Israel, per Reuters report context. (Source: @New_security8200/203591)
Israeli forces began heavy attacks on Mount Ali Taha ridge in southern Lebanon, with operations ongoing against Hezbollah infrastructure. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80274)
US VP Vance stated 15 million barrels of oil exited the Strait of Hormuz the previous day and declared Iran will not be allowed to become a nuclear-armed power. (Source: @VahidOnline/78224)

sections.executive_summary: Israeli Defense Minister Katz threatened that an Iranian attack would trigger strikes on all Iranian infrastructure including energy, returning Iran to "the Stone Age." Netanyahu separately declared all Israeli systems are actively working to topple the Iranian regime. Iran warned the US through diplomatic channels that any Israeli military operation to capture the Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon — where IRGC and Hezbollah forces are positioned — would provoke a severe Iranian response, signaling a dangerous escalation threshold.
iran: Iran warned Washington via Reuters that any Israeli attack on IRGC and Hezbollah positions at Mount Ali al-Taher ridge in southern Lebanon would trigger a severe Iranian response, according to informed sources cited by the agency. (Source: @inon_yttach/10007)

Israeli Channel 14 cited a senior political source stating Iran feels it has reached a dead end and that renewed war is the only way out, describing the indicators as serious. (Source: @kianmeli1/91489)
Channel 14 also stated in breaking news that Israel has received "serious signs" of possible resumption of war by Iran. (Source: @kianmeli1/91501)
Iranian media reported at least 13 military and Revolutionary Guards personnel were killed in American strikes this week. (Source: @asafroz/53060)
Kuwait announced it is responding to a missile and drone attack from Iran approximately one hour prior to the announcement. (Source: @asafroz/53031)

Iranian Foreign Ministry statement cited a Qatari official document submitted to the International Telecommunication Union stating that Iranian defensive strikes against US forces on Qatari territory were directed solely at American military facilities. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89337)
israel: IDF spokesperson announced that troops have completed clearing Hezbollah's underground infrastructure in the Ali Taha ridge, with the 36th Division operating in the area to neutralize the cleared tunnel routes. Forces achieved operational control above and below ground, eliminating some terrorists while others fled the area. (Source: @amitsegal/64552)

DM Katz addressed Defense Ministry employees warning that Iranian pressure, fear of uprising, and regime collapse could push Iran to desperate steps, and stated an Iranian attack on Israel would free Israel of all restrictions to strike all infrastructure including energy. (Source: @almogboker78/18121)

Netanyahu told i24 News that Israel will topple and defeat the Iranian regime, stating it is on the verge of collapse and that all Israeli institutions under his direction are working to achieve this. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80267)

IDF Chief of Staff Zamir stated at an appreciation conference that the IDF must expand, increase its serving personnel pool, and adapt in scale and advanced capabilities to meet expanding missions, while emphasizing the supreme obligation to care for regular, career, reservist, and civilian IDF employees. (Source: @inon_yttach/10012)
DM Katz is conducting a multi-arena situation assessment together with the IDF Chief of Staff and senior security officials against the backdrop of Iranian threats. (Source: @almogboker78/18124)

Israel released approximately 5 Lebanese detainees today as a political gesture in the shadow of negotiations, including transferring Alek Kamal Ghazi to Lebanon at the Naqoura crossing as a goodwill gesture. (Source: @New_security8200/203596)
gaza_west_bank: Reports describe heavy gunfire from occupation mechanisms around the Senafour area east of the Tuffah neighborhood in eastern Gaza City. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388707)

A criticism circulated questioning whether Netanyahu's claims of controlling Mount Ali Taha ridge constitute a real achievement given only access points and limited weapons/equipment reportedly seized, compared to a picture of complete control. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/388698)
A US Gulfstream V electronic reconnaissance aircraft (N926MB) was tracked over Palestine at 6,350 ft altitude. (Source: @redlinkleb/40606)

Heavy Israeli army attacks began on Mount Ali Taha ridge with expectations of the hill's imminent fall. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/80274)

Iranian border guards in Sistan and Baluchestan province discovered heavy military equipment including 4 RPG-7 launchers, 6 anti-armor RPG rounds, 6 RPG warheads, 2,382 Kalashnikov rounds, and 796 M4 rounds during clashes with armed smugglers who intended to use them for sabotage. (Source: @SharghDaily/181707)

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of Netanyahu's explicit declaration of regime-change intentions toward Iran, DM Katz's threat to strike all Iranian infrastructure including energy facilities, and Iran's warning through diplomatic channels regarding the Ali al-Taher ridge creates an extremely high risk of major escalation. The Israeli security establishment's assessment that Hezbollah is actively attempting to drag Iran into a wider conflict, combined with reports of "serious signs" Iran is considering renewed war, suggests both sides are positioning for a potentially larger confrontation. The IDF's completion of underground infrastructure clearing in Ali Taha ridge may be perceived by Iran as crossing the threshold it explicitly warned against, raising the likelihood of direct Iranian retaliation in the near term.
sections.regional_response: Kuwait announced it is responding to an Iranian missile and UAV attack, signaling direct Gulf state involvement in any Iran-Israel exchange. The US, per VP Vance, is coordinating secretly with Turkey, Azerbaijan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar to economically punish Iran for attacks on commercial shipping, demonstrating broad regional alignment against Iranian actions. Qatar submitted documentation to the ITU defending Iranian strikes on US forces on its territory as targeting only military facilities, suggesting potential Qatari-Iranian diplomatic coordination that complicates the Gulf consensus against Iran. Iran's media reported at least 13 military and IRGC personnel killed in US strikes this week, indicating ongoing American military pressure.
sections.intelligence_notes: The presence of a US Gulfstream V electronic reconnaissance aircraft (N926MB) tracked over Palestine at 6,350 ft altitude indicates active US ISR collection supporting regional operations. Reports of a senior Iranian missile commander Sardar Jafar Kahrizi's assassination in a US strike on Kermanshah two nights prior, if accurate, represents a significant decapitation strike against Iranian missile forces. Iranian border forces in Sistan and Baluchestan intercepted heavy weapons including 4 RPG-7s and thousands of rounds intended for sabotage operations, suggesting active Iranian efforts to arm proxies or conduct operations on its own territory. Vance's reference to operations "Midnight Hammer" and "Epic Fury" against Iranian nuclear and defense industrial facilities indicates the US has conducted major strikes on Iranian strategic infrastructure in recent months.
